work.text: Speaker catalog: VP Strategics and Field CTO, JFrog.

Ronen Lewit is the Global Field CTO & VP of Strategic Customers Solutions at JFrog, where he leads the architects teams designing hybrid and cloud software supply chain architectures, closely engaged with Fortune 100 enterprises.

A former startup founder and enterprise CTO, Ronen brings deep expertise in AI software supply chain security, DevOps, and scaling high-growth tech teams to help organizations deliver software safely and continuously at scale.
